 By Sneha Kulkarni , ET Online Last Updated: Nov 04, 2026, 06:00:41 PM IST Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis
 Gold and silver prices have risen as Dhanteras and Diwali approach, sparking increased shopping interest. Major jewellery brands reported higher rates for 22k gold jewellery across various cities today. Tanishq, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Joyalukkas, and Kalyan Jewellers all raised their Gold rates significantly. The India Bullion and Jewellers Association also released updated indicative rates for gold. Listen to this article in summarized format
 Listen ET Online ​Gold rate today: 24k vs 22k vs 20k vs 18k prices​ Gold and silver prices moved higher today (Wednesday, November 4, 2026) as Dhanteras and Diwali draw closer, keeping precious metals in focus for buyers planning their festive purchases. On Wednesday, major jewellery brands, including Tanishq, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Joyalukkas and Kalyan Jewellers, reported an increase in 22 carat gold rates.
 Gold-silver outlook
Prithviraj Kothari, Managing Director at RiddiSiddhi Bullions Ltd., President of IBJA says "Gold and silver rebounded as the US dollar weakened on early Democratic gains in the US midterm elections, with the party possibly taking both chambers of Congress. That raises the prospect of gridlock and tighter government spending. A Democratic sweep could hurt tech stocks and growth, lifting safe-haven demand and pushing bond yields lower, which helped drag the dollar to its lowest since late September. Iran and the US remain far from a deal. Markets await non-farm payrolls for Fed clues. Technically, both metals are bouncing from oversold levels, with gold eyeing $4050 (~Rs 143,500) and silver $54 (~Rs 197,000)."

 Gold and silver rates today (Wednesday, November 4, 2026)
Here is a look at 22k gold jewellery rates from Tanishq, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Kalyan Jewellers and Joyalukkas across New Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata. Also have a look at the India Bullion and Jewellers Association’s (IBJA) 24k, 22k, 20k, 18k and 14k indicative gold jewellery rates and the 999-purity silver jewellery indicative price today.
 22k gold rate at Tanishq today
As of November 4, 2026, Tanishq's price of 22k gold jewellery is Rs 12,875 per gram across New Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Thiruvananthapuram, Coimbatore and Bengaluru. On November 3, 2026, the same variety of gold at Tanishq was priced at Rs 12,800 per gram.
 22k gold price at Malabar Gold & Diamonds today
As of November 4, 2026, Malabar Gold & Diamonds' 22k gold jewellery price is Rs 13,090 per gram across New Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Thiruvananthapuram, Coimbatore and Bengaluru. On November 3, 2026, the 22k gold rate at the same brand was Rs 12,800 per gram.

As of November 4, 2026, Joyalukkas’ 22k gold jewellery price is Rs 13,090 per gram across New Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Thiruvananthapuram, Coimbatore and Bengaluru. On November 3, 2026, the 22k gold rate at the same brand was Rs 12,800 per gram.
